card.name: Words just before a noun or phrase continues
card.fires_on: Varied single words in label text where a noun phrase is still unfolding, such as 'Growth' in 'Effect on Growth', 'and' in a drug list, or 'of' after 'instillation'. No single word type dominates.

modes.label: Heading nouns
modes.description: The noun 'Growth' in the section heading 'Effect on Growth'.
modes.example: 5.18 Effect on<< Growth>> Orally inhaled corticosteroids

modes.label: Linking words in drug phrases
modes.description: 'and' or 'of' joining drug names or following a procedure noun.
modes.example: dextroamphetamine sulfate<< and>> amphetamine sulfate tablets treatment.

modes.label: Technique modifiers
modes.description: Words in procedure descriptions that come before a technique or tool noun.
modes.example: using<< strict>> aseptic technique into the upper anterior
